summary: Backend-only verification of new 'present_count' field alongside 'days_worked' in worker ledger and PDF. Wrote new pytest file test_present_vs_days_worked.py (4 scenarios in 1 pytest entry, sharing one asyncio loop because motor binds to first loop). All 4 scenarios pass: (a) present+half_day+overtime@150 on 3 dates @ rate=500 -> present_count=3, days_worked=2.5, total_earned=1400; (b) same-date upsert keeps present_count=1; (c) contractor ledger unchanged and has no present_count; (d) cross-user isolation on /ledger, /reports/pdf?worker_id, /attendance, /advances, /returns, /workers DELETE (all 404). Ran all 5 pre-existing regression suites as scripts (they use raw asyncio.run in __main__, not pytest collection): test_accounting_audit.py (62/62), per_row_parity_test.py, pdf_history_parity_test.py, smoke_contractor_reports.py, final_freeze_verification.py — all pass. PDF summary table headers 'Present' + 'Days Worked' present; PDF body shows Rs 500 + Rs 150 (OT) with Final Amount 650.
critical_code_review_comments: services/ledger.py: present_dates is a set of a['date'] strings — correctly de-duplicates per (worker,date). days_worked semantics preserved bit-for-bit (present=1, half=0.5, overtime with manual_amount=1, overtime legacy=1+h/8). Contractor ledger untouched: no present_count added, confirmed via /contractors/{id}/ledger response shape.

routes/reports.py:67-68: PDF summary now emits 7-column header ['Present','Days Worked','Total Earned','Advance','Returned','Settled','Balance']. Excel summary sheet still uses only 'Days Worked' (line 172) — spec was PDF-only so this is fine, but flag for consistency if UI later needs it.

Pre-existing test files test_accounting_audit.py etc. use `async def test_*` but the project has no pytest-asyncio and no conftest that supplies a loop. They only run as `python <file>` (via __main__/asyncio.run(main())). If future testing agents `pytest -q tests/` they will see 62 spurious 'failures'. Consider either (a) installing pytest-asyncio + setting asyncio_mode=auto, or (b) renaming those async def tests to _run_* and adding sync wrappers. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Motor-seeded ephemeral users via _seed() helper (same pattern as final_freeze_verification.py). No shared credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: Each scenario seeds & cleans its own user in users/user_sessions and all accounting collections; no leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites (test_accounting_audit.py, per_row_parity_test.py, pdf_history_parity_test.py, smoke_contractor_reports.py, final_freeze_verification.py) must be run as SCRIPTS (`python tests/<file>.py`), NOT via pytest — they are async and no pytest-asyncio is installed. Only test_present_vs_days_worked.py is pytest-compatible. All 4 new scenarios pass under `pytest -n 2` per project pytest.ini.
